readerCopy.body: Someone who already cares about you may be able to make the next step easier, but they need a concrete way to help. When Venus sextiles the North Node, relationships, money, goodwill, and shared resources can make a change more workable through an introduction, place to stay, recommendation, shared expense, flexible schedule, or another form of practical support. Do not make care guess what care is supposed to do. Ask for the specific thing that would change what is possible and let the people who want to be part of your life show up in a form you can actually use.
